info.title: LubanCAD RpcInterface Contracts
info.description:
Machine-generated from packages/shared RpcInterface definitions (scripts/generate-openapi.ts).
Do not edit by hand; regenerate via `pnpm gen:openapi` and commit the result.

Excluded from v1 (registered):
- LubanIpcInterface: non-RpcInterface IPC channel (IpcApp luban-ipc), not HTTP-addressable.
- Server-side zod registry (luban-backend FeatureTypeRegistry) op parameter schemas: later wave.

B-model P2.2 v1.18：创建 Part Studio（唯一创建者）——显式初始化 def/phys model + init BodySolid，并在 def 分区 JsonProperties.luban.partStudio 写注册表元数据。 空/scoped 文档可建；legacy/mixed/unknown 文档诚实拒收；名称 trim 后非空且 ≤120 字符。 `sessionId` 必填且须持有该 iModel 的写租约（assertHeld 失败→拒收，不建任何东西）。
